data.raw_text:
Pinangunahan ni Mayor Joy Belmonte ang pamamahagi ng financial assistance sa mga pamilyang naapektuhan ng sunog sa NIA Road, Barangay Pinyahan.

Kasama sa programa sina Councilor Atty. Vincent Belmonte, Councilor Imee Rillo, Councilor Nanette Castelo-Daza, at Punong Barangay Ricardo Villaflor, gayundin ang Social Services Development Department sa pangunguna ni OIC Lorelei Salvador.

Kasama sa programa sina Councilor Atty. Vincent Belmonte, Councilor Imee Rillo, Councilor Nanette Castelo-Daza, at Punong Barangay Ricardo Villaflor, gayundin ang Social Services Development Department sa pangunguna ni OIC Lorelei Salvador.
data.english_translation: Mayor Joy Belmonte led the distribution of financial science to families affected by the fire at NIA Road, Barangy Pinyhan. The program included Councilor Atty. Vincent Belmonte, Council Imee Rillo, Councilor Nanette Castelo-Daza, and Chief Bargay Ricardo Villaflor, as well as the Social Services Development Department under OICrele Salvador.
